name: Verminkin
source: Black Death City Playtest v1.03, pp.73-92 (printed page numbers)

strongholds.name: Desecrated Chapel
strongholds.text: Prayers of Plague: before determining prepared spells, pick 1 Priest; you choose their prepared spell.

strongholds.name: Hidden Vantage
strongholds.text: Run the Roofs: when told to set up near an entry point, up to d3 of those fighters may instead set up off the battlefield floor, wholly within 12" horizontally of the centre and more than 9" from enemies.

strongholds.name: Rickety Workshop
strongholds.text: Mad Tinkerers: roll injuries for Contraptions twice and pick; 1 Sparkseer may start each battle with 3 engineering points instead of d3.

strongholds.name: Fortified Warren
strongholds.text: Fighting Pits: after a battle, 2 Champions/Henchmen not taken down may fight a pit duel; loser is injured, winner earns 10 XP.

special_rules.name: Master of Plague Magic
special_rules.text: Knows the Lore of Poxes. Pick 2 signature spells; prepare 1 random spell each battle.

special_rules.name: One-cut, One-kill
special_rules.text: While this fighter has made a Charge Move this activation, its melee attack rolls score critical hits on a natural 5 or 6.

special_rules.name: Mad Engineering
special_rules.text: Starts the battle with d3 engineering points. Once per activation, if not engaged, spend 1 for an Engineer bonus action on a friendly fighter within 1" that is not engaged: Patch-up (a Contraption heals d3) or Soup-up (one ranged weapon improves Rend by 1 until end of round, but any misfire is treated as Backfire).

special_rules.name: Holy Magic
special_rules.text: Knows the Lore of Poxes. Pick 1 signature spell; prepare 1 random spell each battle.

special_rules.name: Spellcaster
special_rules.text: Knows the Lore of the Under-Tunnels. Pick 1 signature spell; prepare 1 random spell each battle.

special_rules.name: Mad Engineering
special_rules.text: Starts the battle with d3 engineering points. Once per activation, if not engaged, spend 1 for an Engineer bonus action on a friendly fighter within 1" that is not engaged: Patch-up (a Contraption heals d3) or Soup-up (one ranged weapon improves Rend by 1 until end of round, but any misfire is treated as Backfire).

special_rules.name: One-cut, One-kill
special_rules.text: While this fighter has made a Charge Move this activation, its melee attack rolls score critical hits on a natural 5 or 6.

special_rules.name: Unpredictable Movement
special_rules.text: Move value is 2d6", rolled each time it makes a move (a Run Move then adds d6 as normal).

special_rules.name: Splat!
special_rules.text: After finishing a Charge Move, pick 1 enemy fighter it is engaged with; that fighter is hit 3 times with the attack (Rend -1, Damage 1).

special_rules.name: Large and Heavy
special_rules.text: Cannot climb or jump. Must be set up on, and finish each move on, the battlefield floor.

armour.name: Heavy Plating
armour.text: Subtract 1 from the Move value of fighters equipped with this armour.

armour.name: Warded Robes
armour.text: Each time targeted by an enemy spell, roll a dice; on a 4+ the spell has no effect on this fighter.

armour.name: Full-Plate
armour.text: Cannot be equipped with two-handed ranged weapons, except a Brace of Pistols.

items.name: Bomb Rat
items.text: Once per battle bonus action while not engaged: summon a Giant Rat within 3" with a fuse length 1-6. Each time it activates roll a dice: higher than the fuse = detonate (blast template on the rat, each other fighter hit with the attack, rat taken down, not counted for flee tests); otherwise it activates and the fuse drops by 1 (min 1). If taken down before detonating, roll to see if it detonates.

items.name: Clan Banner
items.text: While on the battlefield you can re-roll flee tests. Re-roll Willpower tests for friendly fighters within 12" that can see this fighter.

items.name: Ensorcelled Bell
items.text: Once per battle, re-roll a miscast roll made for this fighter.

items.name: Grappling Hook
items.text: This fighter can climb high walls in the same manner as ladders.

items.name: Grimoire
items.text: Once per battle, after this fighter has made a casting roll, you can re-roll the casting roll.

items.name: Net
items.text: Once per battle, at the start of a melee attack action this fighter is in, take an Initiative test; if passed the enemy is entwined: -1 Attacks on their melee weapons (off-hand unaffected). An entwined fighter may take an Initiative test each activation to escape.

items.name: Periscope
items.text: While this fighter hasn't moved this activation, add 5" to the Range of its two-handed ranged weapons (not Flame).

items.name: Smoke Bomb
items.text: Once per battle bonus action while engaged: remove and set up wholly within 6" of its previous position, not engaged.

items.name: Wheel-Spikes
items.text: Improve the Rend of this fighter's Crushing Bulk and its Splat! attack by 1.

spells.name: Shadow Leap
spells.text: Pick a visible friendly fighter within 3" (may be the caster); set it up again anywhere within 9" of the caster, not engaged.

spells.name: Doom
spells.text: A visible enemy within 12" is doomed: once, you can make it re-roll an attack roll, a parry roll or an armour roll.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.text: The closest visible enemy within 12" is hit; then another enemy within 3" of it and visible to it is hit with the same attack.
spells.crit_text: A third target within 3" of the first two.

spells.name: Tunnel from Below
spells.text: Blast template on the battlefield floor within 12", scatter d6"; set up d3 friendly fighters from Reserve in it, not engaged.

spells.name: Gathering Shadows
spells.text: Until end of round, friendly fighters within 6" of the caster are in cover.

spells.name: Bouncing Blast
spells.text: Blast template on a visible point within 15", scatters d6"; each fighter in it is hit. Then it scatters d6" again and each fighter in it is hit again.

spells.name: Spray of Vomit
spells.text: Place the flame template from the caster; each fighter in it is hit.

spells.name: Fetid Blades
spells.text: A friendly fighter within 6": 1 melee weapon gains Arcane and Poison until end of round.

spells.name: Rabid Fervour
spells.text: Until end of round, +1 to melee attack rolls for friendly fighters within 6" of the caster.

spells.name: Rotten Armour
spells.text: A visible enemy within 18" worsens Armour by 1 (min '-') for the rest of the round.
spells.crit_text: For the rest of the battle.

spells.name: Dark Vitality
spells.text: Each friendly fighter within 3" of the caster heals 1 life.

spells.name: Plague Bomb
spells.text: Blast template on a visible point within 12", scatters d6"; each fighter in it is hit and becomes poisoned.

skills.name: Purveyor of Poisons
skills.text: Melee weapons gain Poison; a weapon that already has Poison improves Rend by 1 instead.

skills.name: Dirty Fighter
skills.text: -1 to enemy parry rolls against this fighter's attacks; each failed such parry deals 1 damage to the parrying fighter.

skills.name: Attack! Attack!
skills.text: Once per battle bonus action: until end of round, +1 to melee attack rolls for friendly fighters within 9".

skills.name: Too Cunning to Die
skills.text: Campaign: roll twice on the lasting injury table and pick.

skills.name: Master of Dark Science
skills.text: +3" Range to ranged weapons of friendly fighters within 6"; re-roll their misfire rolls.

skills.name: From Unseen Quarter
skills.text: If in reserve, first set-up may be anywhere more than 9" from enemies; up to 2 Henchmen arriving the same round may set up within 3" of it (also >9" from enemies).

skills.name: Impetuous
skills.text: The first Move this fighter makes in battle can move an additional d6".

skills.name: Wall Scrambler
skills.text: Climbs high terrain as if it were a ladder, and can jump as far as its maximum move distance.

skills.name: Ambush
skills.text: +1 Attacks for melee weapons while it has made a Charge Move this activation.

skills.name: Escape Artist
skills.text: Once per battle bonus action while engaged: set up wholly within 2d6" of its previous position, not engaged.

skills.name: Back Stabber
skills.text: Improve Rend of melee weapons by 1 against an enemy engaged with multiple fighters.

skills.name: Shadow Lurker
skills.text: While within 1/2" of any terrain, not visible to enemies more than 9" away.
